leaves.name: mainTheoremCMPolMax
leaves.doc: mtcm-polar: the main theorem of complex multiplication for polarized CM abelian varieties of type (E, Phi; a, zeta) with a a fractional O_E-ideal (Shimura's normalization, eps = 1): for a CM field E with CM type Phi, its reflex field E* and reflex norm N (det_E on a model of C^Phi over E*), sigma in Aut(C) and an idele s of E* with sigma = [s, E*] on E*^ab (Tau Ceti's arithmetic Artin map), an abelian variety A/C uniformized by C^g/Phi(a) of type (E, Phi), a an O_E-ideal lattice, with a Riemann form Tr(zeta x ybar) (zeta-bar = -zeta, Im phi_i(zeta) > 0, integral on a): A^sigma is uniformized by C^g/Phi(N(s)^-1 a) with theta(Phi(x))^sigma = theta'(Phi(y)) whenever N(s)y - x lies in a-hat. Implies hcm-printed's MainTheoremCMArith with CMAbVarExists and the textbook leaves (mainTheoremCMArith_of_polar).
leaves.flag: pending reading: the normalization of Shimura's [s, K] (1971 section 5.2) against Tau Ceti's arithmetic Artin map (eps = 1), as for hcm-printed's MainTheoremCMArith; reading risk: whether Thm 18.6 / 5.15 is printed for non-primitive CM types
leaves.source: Shimura, Introduction to the arithmetic theory of automorphic functions (1971) Thm 5.15 with section 5.5; Shimura, Abelian varieties with complex multiplication and modular functions (1998) section 18, Thm 18.6; Shimura-Taniyama (1961) sections 13-14 (locators UNVERIFIED)

leaves.name: cmAbVarExists
leaves.doc: mtcm-polar: for a CM field E with CM type Phi, a fractional O_E-ideal b and zeta with zeta-bar = -zeta, Im phi_i(zeta) > 0 and Tr(zeta b bbar) in Z, there is an abelian variety B/C of dimension g with an analytic uniformization C^g/Phi(b) = B(C) (existence of a polarized abelian variety of type (E, Phi; b, zeta); the polarization and the action are dropped).
leaves.source: Shimura, Abelian varieties with complex multiplication and modular functions (1998) section 6.2 Thm 4; Shimura-Taniyama (1961) section 6.2 Thm 4; Mumford, Abelian varieties, section 3 (Riemann's theorem) (locators UNVERIFIED)

leaves.name: weierstrassUniformization
leaves.doc: hcm-printed (gz-weil's statement verbatim): for a, b in C with a^3 - 27 b^2 != 0 there is a lattice L with g2(L) = a, g3(L) = b.
leaves.source: Silverman, The Arithmetic of Elliptic Curves (GTM 106, 2nd ed.) Thm VI.5.1; Serre, A Course in Arithmetic VII section 3 (locators UNVERIFIED)

leaves.name: weierstrassParam
leaves.doc: hcm-printed: for every lattice, Delta != 0 and z -> (wp(z), wp'(z)/2) is a surjective group homomorphism C -> E(C) with kernel the lattice (Mathlib's Weierstrass curve y^2 = x^3 - (g2/4)x - g3/4 and its group law); the analytic clause of the print is dropped.
leaves.source: Silverman, The Arithmetic of Elliptic Curves (GTM 106, 2nd ed.) Prop. VI.3.6; Lang, Elliptic functions Ch. 1 section 3 (locators UNVERIFIED)

leaves.name: weierstrassAbVar
leaves.doc: hcm-printed: for every lattice L there are an abelian variety A/C of dimension 1, an analytic uniformization theta : C/L = A(C), and regular functions x, y on an open U with theta(z) in U iff z not in L, x(theta z) = wp(z), y(theta z) = wp'(z): the curve E_L with its affine Weierstrass coordinates and the map [wp, wp', 1].
leaves.flag: pending reading: whether the abelian-variety presentation of E_L (existential A, Mathlib cannot construct the projective cubic as a group scheme) is accepted as the printed form of VI.3.6(b)
leaves.source: Silverman, The Arithmetic of Elliptic Curves (GTM 106, 2nd ed.) Prop. VI.3.6(b) with III.3.1 and Prop. III.3.6 (locators UNVERIFIED)
